{"command":"cat > /tmp/modeltest.py <<'PY'\\nimport pandas as pd,numpy as np,itertools\\np='/media/user/data/agenthle/health_medicine/flusight_offline_hosp_forecast_2024_12_14/base/input/historical_weekly_hospital_admissions_asof_2024-12-14.csv'\\nd=pd.read_csv(p,dtype={'location':str}); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); tab=d.pivot(index='date',columns='location',values='value').sort_index();tab=tab.interpolate(limit_direction='both')\\n# log1p slopes last k via OLS\\n\\ndef slope(s,t,k=5):\\n y=np.log1p(s.loc[:t].tail(k).values); x=np.arange(len(y));return np.polyfit(x,y,1)[0]\\ndef pred(loc,t,h,w,k=5,damp=.85):\\n s=tab[loc]; us=tab.US;base=np.log1p(s[t]);\\n # analog prior year 52 weeks exact\\n a0=t-pd.Timedelta(weeks=52); a1=a0+pd.Timedelta(weeks=h)\\n la=np.log1p(s[a1])-np.log1p(s[a0]); na=np.log1p(us[a1])-np.log1p(us[a0])\\n H=sum(damp**i for i in range(h))\\n lt=slope(s,t,k)*H; nt=slope(us,t,k)*H\\n return max(0,np.expm1(base+w[0]*la+w[1]*na+w[2]*lt+w[3]*nt))\\nrefs=pd.to_datetime(['2023-11-11','2023-11-18','2023-11-25','2023-12-02','2023-12-09','2023-12-16'])\\nlocs=[x for x in tab if x!='US']\\nfor k in [3,4,5,6]:\\n out=[]\\n for vals in itertools.product(range(5),repeat=4):\\n  if sum(vals)!=4:continue\\n  w=np.array(vals)/4\\n  ae=[]\\n  for t in refs:\\n   for h in range(1,5):\\n    for loc in locs:\\n     y=tab.loc[t+pd.Timedelta(weeks=h),loc]; pr=pred(loc,t,h,w,k)\\n     ae.append(abs(pr-y)/(y+20))\\n  out.append((np.mean(ae),np.median(ae),w))\\n print(k,sorted(out,key=lambda z:z[0])[:8])\\nPY\\npython3 /tmp/modeltest.py","timeout":300}
